candidate.raw_translation: Manajan sakamako na cikin gida ga tsarin farawa kai tsaye na ZXQPH0000QXZ/ZXQPH0001QXZ. Ka shigar da sassan da suka faɗi a kan tebur. Yaki zai dawo da sakamako daga kafin wannan ziyara. An yi lissafin shawarwarin fitarwa daga dokokin tebur guda. Za'a iya canza sifofin gasar; babu sakamako ko sunaye da za su bar wannan taswirar.
candidate.source: Local scorekeeper for the common 301/501 straight-start, double-out format. Enter the segments that landed on the board. A bust restores the score from before that visit.
